(This is where you come in.)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655750/e4a04a6f52b79d8eacb808f699a2fabb1fc03bf4.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Follow Artix's Play-by-Play for this test[/h2][p]It is at the bottom of this page.[/p][p][url="https://aq2d.com/posts/techdemo-007/"]https://aq2d.com/posts/techdemo-007/[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Daily Progress Updates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655750/1b8ace818a984c66bec7482908dfd13939916cff.jpg[/img]

[b]Greetings and salutations![/b]

Did you know we have been doing daily progress posts on the official [b][url=https://aq2d.com/]AdventureQuest Worlds: Infinity Website[/url][/b]?

[url=https://aq2d.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42655750/8f4b80fc999e5a3b37358e87521370f26ff8dd88.gif[/img][/url]

This MMORPG project sure has been taking a long while. It would have been way easier to create a brand new game instead of creating the tools and systems to convert 50,000+ unique items, 120 classes, and the maps, story, cutscenes, pets. But it will be worth it. When this game project goes live, you and other players of the original game will be able to login with all of your stuff! 

You probably have a lot of questions, so be sure to read this post for the answers...
[url=https://aq2d.com/posts/aqworlds_infinity_questions_and_answers/][b]AQWorlds Infinity Q&A Post[/b][/url]

Join us for [url=https://www.aq2d.com]daily update posts[/url] as we take AQWorlds Infinity to the finish line. We lace the posts with GIFs for people who zone out reading a wall of behind the scenes game dev story text XD. Once we release, our ongoing weekly content update posts will also be posted here on steam ([i]Just like we do for our weekly updated [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/429790/AdventureQuest_3D/]3D MMORPG[/url][/i])

[b]Battle on!
Artix[/b]
